title: Public Alert No. 37/2025 – Alert on the Report of Substandard and Falsified (SF) BETACLOX found in Nigeria

products.manufacturer: Saeny Laboratory Pvt, Ltd, Elappunkal Junction, Kozhuvanal, Kerala, 864 423 India

summary: NAFDAC warns of substandard/falsified BETACLOX (ampicillin 250mg + cloxacillin 250mg), batch 230701, bearing NAFDAC No. A4 4724 that actually belongs to Chi Ltd's Mebendazole 500mg. Sourced from Gambori Market, Maiduguri and sold in Kano and Zaria.
